title: Sagan bumped up against the UFO program
summary: Bob Maguire tells of Sagan bumped up against the UFO program, about unspecified at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

plain: Bob Maguire, introduced as a former CIA contractor, talks with podcast host Jesse Michels about Carl Sagan, a famous astronomer and science popularizer. Maguire says that, while he does not know it as a fact, it is his belief that Sagan bumped up against a secret UFO program and was told he needed to make changes. If true, it would mean a leading public scientist was quietly steered on the subject.
